thread_AwECHlLnlzKkOkERKhKKawW8.customer_segments: Target segments include global enterprises undergoing digital transformation, creative professionals, SMBs, property hosts, online content creators, and travel experience providers.
thread_AwECHlLnlzKkOkERKhKKawW8.cost_structure: Key costs include R&D for SaaS and AI services, consulting labor, platform infrastructure (cloud services, data centers), partner commissions, customer acquisition marketing, host incentive programs, and regulatory compliance.
